title.narrative: Support to the media-democracy nexus on electoral matters in Zimbabwe

description.narrative: The Global Objective of the Action is to promote a media-aided functioning pluralistic, participatory and representative democracy in Zimbabwe inclusive of all citizens, with specific attention to marginalised and remote communities, through targeted support to the media sector as a vital actor in election cycles and beyond. The Specific Objective of the Action is to enhance a conducive environment for credible elections through strategic capacity strengthening that continues to build on previous efforts engaging the media sector, CSOs and key election actors, including ZEC, the security sector, political parties and constitutional commissions. In order to contribute achieving these goals, the Action is structured around two outcome areas (components) and a series of cross-cutting activities.

title.narrative: Country score for civil and political rights, according to the Freedom House assessment of Global Freedom

description.narrative: Freedom House rates peoples access to political rights and civil liberties in 210 countries and territories through its annual Freedom in the World report.Freedom House uses a twotiered system consisting of scores and status. For the Global Freedom indicator only the score is calculated and provided on the Freedom in the World website. A country or territory is awarded 0 to 4 points for each of 10 political rights indicators and 15 civil liberties indicators, which take the form of questions; a score of 0 represents the smallest degree of freedom and 4 the greatest degree of freedom.For more detail on the methodology, please see: https://freedomhouse.org/reports/freedomworld/freedomworldresearchmethodology
